title: Microsoft Dataverse: richer record labels for Copilot /mention in Microsoft 365 apps
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, environment control, licensing background and documented record behaviour are supported. It distinguishes the label enhancement from the existing search setting and accurately limits its unanswered questions to enhancement-specific defaults, licensing and automation.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: The change gives Dataverse, Dynamics 365 and Power Apps record references richer labels in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: End users of Microsoft 365 Copilot will see improved Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365, and Power Apps record references in Context IQ with richer, more descriptive labels

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the labels as including environment, app and table information.
claims.quote: richer, more descriptive labels that include environment, app, and table information.

claims.claim: The roadmap names the record-reference surface Context IQ.
claims.quote: record references in Context IQ

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn gives the enhanced label format as Environment Name + App Name + Record Name.
claims.quote: Each record is displayed with an enhanced label that includes the **Environment Name** + **App Name** + **Record Name**, helping users quickly identify the correct record and its source.

claims.claim: The /mention experience offers the most recently viewed Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records.
claims.quote: Most recently viewed Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records are available in Microsoft 365 Copilot through the /mention experience

claims.claim: When a record has been viewed through multiple apps, its label reflects the most recently used app.
claims.quote: If you access the same record through multiple apps, the label reflects the most recently used app from which you viewed the record.

claims.where: What's changing; Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: A viewed record can take up to 15 minutes to become available through /mention.
claims.quote: It can take up to 15 minutes after you view a record on your Dynamics 365 or model-driven apps before you can **/mention** that record on Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in your productivity apps, like Outlook web client.

claims.claim: The /mention page documents Outlook on the web, Copilot Chat, Researcher, Word and Teams experiences.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Manage feature settings lists the default value of Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps as On.
claims.quote: | Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps | You can quickly enable your users to access the records they most recently used in their application. The records are available in the Outlook Web client using a simple /mention gesture. | On |

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft does not state enhancement-specific arrival behaviour, so the label enhancement's default state is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse Copilot /mention enhanced labels environment app record name admin switch default rollout; Dataverse enhanced label default. Read roadmap, link-records-outlook-web and settings-features: the search setting has a default, but no separate label-arrival default is specified.

claims.claim: The control is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Search > Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: select **Manage** ... select **Environments** ... select an environment ... select **Settings** ... Expand **Product**, and then select **Features** ... Under the **Search** section, turn on **Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps**.

claims.claim: No API or automation operation is documented for this specific Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps PowerShell Power Platform API pac admin Dataverse organization setting; same setting API; isofficegraphenabled mention Search for records. Read /mention, settings-features and Organization reference; no documented mapping to this setting.

claims.claim: No separate switch for the enhanced label format is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse Copilot /mention enhanced labels environment app record name admin switch default rollout; Dataverse /mention label disable. Read link-records-outlook-web and settings-features; the documented switch controls record search, not label formatting.
